followup.hardware_identity_scope: current metadata only; no new stress calibration

native_configure.topology: independent audio and RF references; effective relative preset accuracy split symmetrically between TX and RX
native_configure.frequency_parameter_scope: RF and conversion-IF values multiply oscillator errors; the sampled signal is zero-centered complex baseband
native_configure.sampling_clock_model: constant endpoint ppm; shared mode correlates static RF/audio ppm and counts base phase diffusion once; stochastic phase does not perturb sampling coordinates

selective_channel.modulation_rate_source: effective spread Doppler; slow component runs at one tenth
selective_channel.frequency_frame: fixed public channel frame; never recentered from hidden oscillator truth
selective_channel.interpretation: dispersive-dft-v1 is a spacing-scaled stress law when the scale is auto; selected ray delay and Doppler remain separate physical dimensions

spread_inputs.semantics: selected preset supplies nominal dimensions; explicit physical overrides replace their own nominal dimension before one margin multiplication; without preset, legacy channel values supply the base, and remain already effective when no override is supplied; receiver tap basis is independent

path_evolution.gaussian_target_correlation: exp(-0.5*(pi*B*tau)^2); B=2*sigma of each ray Gaussian Doppler PSD; existing ray-center separation is independent
path_evolution.gaussian_teacher: stationary proper-complex white Gaussian innovations convolved with a discrete L2-normalized Gaussian FIR; finite truncation and sampling approximate the target covariance; actual FIR shape is reported separately
path_evolution.ray_model: fixed unit ray gains; existing equal-power two-ray delay and Doppler retained when selected
path_evolution.outage_model: signal-only attenuation on [start,end), with cosine descent/ascent inside the interval; thermal noise and path/filter state continue
path_evolution.scope: declared physical-path stress, not field calibration; OU is point sampled and has an unbounded analog spectrum; the Gaussian FIR target also has unbounded spectral tails and its six-sigma-per-edge capture allowance is not strict support, so finite deterministic capture bounds are not a bandwidth guarantee and sampling-rate refinement is required

native_configure.initial_arrival_prior_source: explicit uniform physical arrival prior; replaces clock/audio initial timing only
native_configure.explicit_arrival_seed_domain: channel seed XOR 0x94d049bb133111eb; independent mt19937_64 stream
native_configure.timing_convention: explicit uniform initial physical arrival relative to source support; clock/audio timing draw replaced, endpoint clock-rate and oscillator models preserved
native_configure.truth_selection: initial timing is uniform on the explicit physical prior, drawn from a domain-separated channel-seed stream independent of --start; other configured/legacy draws are unchanged
native_configure.epoch_address_scope: explicit independent keyed-epoch offset; PC timing draws do not silently choose a crypto epoch

search_estimates.timing_model: squared raised-cosine chip autocorrelation times squared equal-power three-carrier Dirichlet factor; first-main-lobe bisection
search_estimates.timing_model_assumptions: independent zero-mean random chips; equal mean carrier powers; one shared complex gain; infinite RRC pulse; worst mismatch half a uniform grid step with both endpoints covered
search_estimates.timing_model_limits: finite keyed patterns, truncated pulse, sampled interpolation, channel uncertainty, outages and clock/timing joint mismatch require independent validation
search_estimates.clock_step_model: endpoint displacement over the complete bit equals timing_maximum_step_seconds; same approximate timing loss budget
search_estimates.scope: finite-grid estimates only; no implicit bank generation, pruning, phase-path count or reception guarantee

capture.scope: whole deterministic RF/audio-error bound, public CFO grid, maximum diurnal instantaneous frequency and Gaussian-ray allowance of six sigma per edge; stochastic oscillator and ray spectral tails are not a bounded capture guarantee
capture.sampling_model_limits: below 64 samples/s: FHSS, dropout, active sampled frontend, slow AGC, white/flicker/random-walk FM and white PM are rejected; constant offsets, Wiener phase, fractional two-ray propagation and selected selective perturbations remain modeled in physical seconds; no high-rate integration/decimation equivalence is claimed

duration.scope: ten-Julian-year requested-active limit; complete private tiles, internal burst waits, pulse padding and channel/capture tails may extend actual elapsed duration

whole_bit_symbol_burst.scope: one-bit source renders this slot only; successor is public calendar metadata, not three internal wait tiles or multi-bit runtime support

receiver_observation.missed_dwell_calendar: floor((n/(Fs*RX_clock_scale) - capture_lead_seconds + retune_offset_seconds - calendar_origin_sample/Fs)/dwell_seconds); only nonnegative public receiver dwell indices are maskable
receiver_observation.erasure_stage: after physical channel, noise and frontend; output I/Q and validity become zero while all physical state advances
receiver_observation.coverage_policy_scope: C++ run receiver only; complete-calendar requirement and likelihood thresholds remain unchanged; external scorers declare their own coverage policy

configuration.fixture_generation: native sampled point model; continuous path/channel state and full natural tails retained
